journal_name: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

articles.title_cn: 地方性便利设施的国民支出
articles.abstract_en: We develop a framework for estimating Americans’ implicit expenditures on spatially varying nonmarket amenities. We focus on location-specific factors that affect the quality of life but are not formally traded. Examples include climate, geography, pollution, local public goods, and transportation infrastructure. Households pay for residential access to these amenities indirectly, through housing prices, wages and property taxes. We construct a database of 75 amenities, match it to 5 million households’ location choices, and use hedonic methods to estimate their total amenity expenditures. Our benchmark estimate for the year 2000 is $562 billion--equivalent to 8% of Americans’ personal consumption expenditures.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个框架来估算美国人对空间变化的非市场便利设施的隐性支出。我们关注那些影响生活质量但未正式交易的区位特定因素。例子包括气候、地理、污染、地方公共物品和交通基础设施。家庭通过房价、工资和财产税间接为居住在这些便利设施附近付费。我们构建了一个包含75项便利设施的数据库，将其与5万户家庭的区位选择相匹配，并使用特征价格法来估算他们的总便利设施支出。我们2000年的基准估计为562亿美元——相当于美国人个人消费支出的8%。

articles.abstract_en: Foreign aid allocation by donor countries to developing economies is known to be motivated by the donor country’s bilateral trade interests. Does this apply also to bilateral climate aid? In this paper, we combine theoretical and empirical analyses to investigate how bilateral trade affects donor countries’ allocations of bilateral climate aid. Our theoretical analysis develops a simple model to support our hypothesis that bilateral trade has a positive impact on climate aid transfers. The model highlights the terms-of-trade and positive income effects of climate aid, and predicts a positive relationship between donor countries’ exports to and imports from recipient countries and their climate aid transfers. The empirical analysis is based on bilateral climate aid data for 2002 to 2017. We employ fixed effects and instrumental variable-2 stage least square estimations (IV-2SLS) with a shift-share instrument to overcome the endogeneity of trade. Our empirical results show that donors’ exports have a significant, robust, positive effect on climate aid transfers.
articles.abstract_cn: 众所周知，捐助国向发展中经济体分配外国援助是出于捐助国的双边贸易利益。这是否也适用于双边气候援助？在本文中，我们结合理论和实证分析来研究双边贸易如何影响捐助国双边气候援助的分配。我们的理论分析开发了一个简单的模型来支持我们的假设，即双边贸易对气候援助转移具有积极影响。该模型强调了气候援助的贸易条件和积极的收入影响，并预测捐助国对受援国的出口和进口与其气候援助转移之间存在正相关关系。实证分析基于2002至2017的双边气候援助数据。我们采用固定效应和工具变量2阶段最小二乘估计（IV-2SLS）和移位份额工具来克服贸易的内生性。我们的实证结果表明，捐助者的出口对气候援助转移具有显着、强劲和积极的影响。

articles.title_en: Quantifying COVID-19’s silver lining: Avoided deaths from air quality improvements in Bogotá
articles.title_cn: 量化COVID-19的一线希望：波哥大空气质量改善所避免的死亡
articles.abstract_en: In cities around the world, COVID-19 lockdowns have significantly improved outdoor air quality. Even if only temporary, these improvements could have longer-lasting effects by making chronic air pollution more salient and boosting political pressure for change. To that end, it is important to develop objective estimates of both the air quality improvements associated with lockdowns and the benefits they generate. We use panel data econometric models to estimate the effect of Bogotá’s 16-month lockdown on PM2.5 and NO2 pollution, epidemiological models to simulate the effect of reductions in these pollutants on long- and short-term mortality, and benefit transfer methods to value the avoided mortality. We find that on average, Bogotá’s lockdown cut PM2.5 pollution by 15% and NO2 pollution by 21%. However, the magnitude of these effects varied considerably over time and across the city's neighborhoods. Equivalent permanent reductions in these pollutants would reduce long-term premature deaths from air pollution by 23% each year, a benefit valued at $1 billion annually. Finally, we estimate that if they occurred ceteris paribus, the temporary reductions in pollutant concentrations in 2020–2021 due to Bogotá’s lockdown would have cut short-term deaths from air pollution by 19%, a benefit valued at $244 million.
articles.abstract_cn: 在世界各地的城市中，COVID-19封锁显著改善了室外空气质量。即使这些改善只是暂时的，它们也可能通过使慢性空气污染问题更加突出并增强政治变革压力而产生更持久的影响。为此，重要的是要客观估计封锁带来的空气质量改善及其产生的效益。我们使用面板数据计量经济模型来估计波哥大16个月封锁对PM2.5和NO2污染的影响，使用流行病学模型来模拟这些污染物减少对长期和短期死亡率的影响，并使用效益转移方法来评估避免死亡的货币价值。我们发现，平均而言，波哥大的封锁使PM2.5污染降低了15%，NO2污染降低了21%。然而，这些影响的幅度在时间和城市各社区之间存在显著差异。这些污染物的等效永久性减少将使每年因空气污染导致的长期过早死亡减少23%，这一效益每年价值1亿美元。最后，我们估计，如果其他条件不变，2020-2021年波哥大封锁导致的污染物浓度暂时性减少将使空气污染导致的短期死亡减少19%，这一效益价值244亿美元。

articles.title_en: Tax incentives, environmental regulation and firms’ emission reduction strategies: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 税收激励、环境规制与企业减排策略：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Policy interaction is an important way to deal with increasingly complex environmental problems. This paper examines the investment-related tax cuts and the policy interaction with environmental regulation on firms' emission reduction strategies. Taking China's value-added tax (VAT) reform as a quasi-natural experiment and considering the interaction with the emission reduction target policy, our difference-in-differences estimation shows that: the average effect of the VAT reform reduces firms' sulfur dioxide (SO2) emission intensity by 16.6%, due to the adoption of emissions reduction strategies in the production processes; the interaction effect between the VAT reform and environmental regulation incentivizes firms to additionally reduce SO2 emission intensity, due to the adoption of both production processes and end-of-pipe reduction strategies. Our findings are more evident for firms with tight financial constraints. Overall, this paper reveals the micro-mechanisms of how the tax policies incentivize firms to choose emission reduction strategies and highlights the importance of the interaction effects between environmental and non-environmental policies, thus providing implications for the policy mix of environmental regulation and tax-cut incentives to promote pollution reduction and improve business performance.
articles.abstract_cn: 政策互动是应对日益复杂的环境问题的重要途径。本文考察了与投资相关的税收减免及其与环境规制在企业的减排策略上的政策互动。以中国的增值税改革作为准自然实验，并考虑与减排目标政策的互动，我们的双重差分估计表明：增值税改革的平均效应使企业的二氧化硫（SO2）排放强度降低了16.6%，这是由于在生产过程中采用了减排策略；增值税改革与环境规制之间的互动效应激励企业额外降低SO2排放强度，这是由于同时采用了生产过程和末端治理的减排策略。我们的发现在财务约束紧张的企业中更为明显。总体而言，本文揭示了税收政策如何激励企业选择减排策略的微观机制，并强调了环境政策与非环境政策之间互动效应的重要性，从而为环境规制与减税激励的政策组合以促进污染减排和改善企业绩效提供了启示。

articles.title_en: First lead, now no bed? The unintended impacts of lead abatement laws on eviction
articles.title_cn: 先铅中毒，现在无家可归？铅消除法对驱逐的意外影响
articles.abstract_en: Lead paint in old houses is the leading cause of lead poisoning in children under 6 today. To combat this problem, several states have passed lead abatement laws, forcing landlords to remove lead in the homes they rent if tenants have children under the age of 6. However, these laws have unintended consequences, causing landlords to evict tenants rather than abate lead. I use a difference-in-differences approach while employing various model specifications with various fixed effects and sets of controls to examine the impact of Ohio’s 2003 lead abatement law on eviction rates. Using newly collected data from the Eviction Lab at Princeton University, I find that the passage of Ohio’s lead abatement law sharply increased targeted evictions. Due to the law’s passage, the average census district in Ohio faced an increased eviction rate of roughly 0.457 points, corresponding to an additional 13.93 evictions a year. These impacts are highly statistically significant, sizeable, and economically meaningful, indicating that policy makers should incorporate distributional consequences when designing future lead abatement laws in order to avoid unintended consequences and ensure equitable outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 老房子中的含铅涂料是当今6岁以下儿童铅中毒的主要原因。为了解决这一问题，几个州通过了铅消除法，强制房东在租户有6岁以下儿童时清除其出租房屋中的铅。然而，这些法律产生了意想不到的后果，导致房东驱逐租户而非消除铅。我采用双重差分法，同时使用各种固定效应和控制变量组合的多种模型设定，考察俄亥俄州2003年铅消除法对驱逐率的影响。利用从普林斯顿大学驱逐实验室新收集的数据，我发现俄亥俄州铅消除法的通过急剧增加了针对性的驱逐。由于该法律的通过，俄亥俄州的平均人口普查区面临约0.457个百分点的驱逐率上升，相当于每年额外增加13.93起驱逐。这些影响在统计上高度显著、规模可观且具有经济意义，表明政策制定者在设计未来的铅消除法时应纳入分配后果，以避免意外影响并确保公平结果。

articles.title_en: Cross-border environmental regulation and firm labor demand
articles.title_cn: 跨境环境规制与企业劳动力需求
articles.abstract_en: In 1994, due to environmental concerns, Germany banned a chemical called ‘Azo-dyes’, a primary input for the leather and textiles firms in India (a key exporter). Exploiting this as a quasi-natural experiment, we examine the effects of this cross-border regulatory change on labor compensation, particularly managerial, for both Indian upstream (dye-producing) and downstream (leather and textile) firms. We find that the regulation increased compensation of managers by 1.3%–18% in dye-producing firms compared to other chemical firms. This is due to the combination of changes such as investing in R&D, product churning, import of high-quality intermediates, due to the ban, which led to this change in within-firm labor composition. This increase in overall compensation is driven only by fixed component (wages), consistent with the effects of a long-run shock. We find no such effects for downstream firms. We believe, our study is one of the first to show that just like tariff, non-tariff barriers (NTBs) can also significantly affect within-firm labor composition.
articles.abstract_cn: 在1994年，出于环境考虑，德国禁止了一种名为“偶氮染料”的化学品，这是印度皮革和纺织企业的主要投入品（印度是主要出口国）。利用这一事件作为准自然实验，我们考察了这一跨境监管变化对印度上游（染料生产）和下游（皮革和纺织）企业劳动力补偿，特别是管理层补偿的影响。我们发现，与其他化工企业相比，该法规使染料生产企业的管理者补偿增加了1.3%–18%。这是由于禁令导致的研发投资、产品更替、高质量中间品进口等变化的组合，进而引起了企业内部劳动力构成的这种变化。总体补偿的增加仅由固定部分（工资）驱动，这与长期冲击的影响一致。我们未发现对下游企业有此类影响。我们认为，我们的研究是首批表明非关税壁垒（NTBs）与关税一样，也能显著影响企业内部劳动力构成的研究之一。

articles.title_en: Is environmental regulation the answer to pollution problems in urbanizing economies?
articles.title_cn: 环境规制是城市化经济体污染问题的答案吗？
articles.abstract_en: This paper seeks to better understand the persistent environmental problems in urbanizing economies. We examine the effectiveness of environmental policy in an economy with agglomeration economies and endogenous firm relocation and entry/exit. We show that, although environmental regulation is effective in the short run, in the presence of agglomeration economies, spatial relocation of firms in response to environmental regulation can undermine the effectiveness of regulations, rendering them less effective or even ineffective. In fact, we show that regulation might even be counter-productive, i.e., exacerbate environmental problems, at certain stages of development. We present initial empirical evidence in the context of water pollution in China that demonstrates the importance of agglomeration economies in determining the impacts of environmental regulation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文旨在更好地理解城市化经济体中持续存在的环境问题。我们考察了在集聚经济和内生企业迁移及进入/退出条件下环境政策的有效性。我们表明，尽管环境规制在短期内有效，但在集聚经济存在的情况下，企业为应对环境规制而进行的空间迁移可能会削弱规制的有效性，使其效果降低甚至无效。事实上，我们表明，在发展的某些阶段，规制甚至可能适得其反，即加剧环境问题。我们提供了中国水污染背景下的初步经验证据，证明了集聚经济在决定环境规制影响中的重要性。

articles.title_en: Policy evaluation of waste pricing programs using heterogeneous causal effect estimation
articles.title_cn: 基于异质性因果效应估计的垃圾定价政策评估
articles.abstract_en: Using machine learning methods in a quasi-experimental setting, I study the heterogeneous effects of introducing waste prices – unit prices on household unsorted waste disposal – on waste demands and municipal costs. Using a unique panel of Italian municipalities with large variation in prices and observables, I show that waste demands are nonlinear. I find evidence of constant elasticities at low prices, and increasing elasticities at high prices driven by income effects and waste habits before policy. The policy reduces waste management costs in all municipalities after three years of adoption, when prices cause significant reductions in total waste.
articles.abstract_cn: 在准实验环境中使用机器学习方法，我研究了引入垃圾价格（对家庭未分类垃圾处理征收的单位价格）对垃圾需求和市政成本的异质性影响。利用意大利市政当局的独特面板数据，其中价格和可观测变量存在较大差异，我表明垃圾需求是非线性的。我发现了低价格下弹性恒定的证据，以及高价格下弹性增加，这由收入效应和政策前的垃圾习惯驱动。该政策在采用三年后降低了所有市政的垃圾管理成本，此时价格导致总垃圾显著减少。

articles.title_en: The mortality impact of fine particulate matter in China: Evidence from trade shocks
articles.title_cn: 细颗粒物对中国死亡率的影响：来自贸易冲击的证据
articles.abstract_en: We use county-level panel data to estimate the long-run effect of fine particulate matter (PM2.5) pollution on mortality in China. Our causal inference relies on changes in local pollution via wind transport and demand shocks of Chinese products from export destinations amid the global economic crisis during the late 2000s. We find an economically and statistically significant impact of long-term exposure to PM2.5 on cardiovascular and respiratory mortality, and the effect is the largest for those 65 years and older. Using the substantial variation in pollution levels both across time and space in China, we provide evidence of a concave dose-response function, with diminishing marginal mortality impacts of pollution at levels beyond those in developed nations.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用县级面板数据来估计细颗粒物（PM2.5）污染对中国死亡率的长期影响。我们的因果推断依赖于当地污染通过风输送的变化，以及2000年代末全球经济危机期间中国产品来自出口目的地的需求冲击。我们发现长期暴露于PM2.5对心血管和呼吸系统死亡率具有经济和统计上显著的影响，且对65岁及以上人群的影响最大。利用中国污染水平在时间和空间上的显著变化，我们提供了凹形剂量-反应函数的证据，即在超过发达国家的水平后，污染的边际死亡率影响递减。

articles.title_en: Do non-damaging earthquakes shake mortgage lenders' risk perception?
articles.title_cn: 无破坏性地震是否动摇了抵押贷款机构的风险认知？
articles.abstract_en: This study examines how banks respond to earthquakes that convey seismic risk salience but do not cause damage, i.e., noticeable non-damaging earthquakes (NNDEs). Using evidence from California, we find loans more likely to be denied or sold after increased NNDEs. Banks with fewer assets, more diversified branching markets, or stronger sales capability relied more on securitization to transfer the perceived seismic risk. We show evidence that banks likely learned about the NNDEs through personal experience and local news. The effects of NNDEs persisted up to three years. Meanwhile, the NNDEs only caused moderate and temporary collateral devaluation but did not increase the observable default risk. Thus, banks' responses most likely resulted from the increased risk salience of future damaging earthquakes during the mortgage term. Our findings call for reevaluations of the heuristics in banks' risk-perception updating and have implications for designing more efficient disaster risk-sharing mechanisms in the financial market.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了银行如何应对那些传递地震风险显著性但不造成破坏的地震，即可感知的无破坏性地震（NNDEs）。利用加利福尼亚州的证据，我们发现，在NNDEs增加后，贷款更有可能被拒绝或出售。资产较少、分支市场更多元化或销售能力更强的银行更依赖证券化来转移感知到的地震风险。我们提供的证据表明，银行可能通过个人经历和当地新闻了解到NNDEs。NNDEs的影响持续了长达三年。同时，NNDEs仅导致适度和暂时的抵押品贬值，但并未增加可观察的违约风险。因此，银行的最可能反应源于抵押贷款期间未来破坏性地震风险显著性的增加。我们的研究结果呼吁重新评估银行风险认知更新中的启发式方法，并对在金融市场中设计更有效的灾害风险分担机制具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: Spatial and temporal responses to incentives: An application to wildlife disease management
articles.title_cn: 对激励的空间与时间响应：野生动物疾病管理的一个应用
articles.abstract_en: When participating in recreation individuals decide on where to go (locations) and when to participate (which time periods), and they respond to changes in external factors (e.g., environmental quality changes, provision of incentives). In examining economic decision-making, economists focus mostly on location choices, thus the behavioral and welfare impacts of the incentives associated with time choices are largely unknown. In this paper, we develop and estimate a flexible econometric model that combines spatial and temporal choices. The model is applied to examine individuals’ location and time choices of their recreation trips in response to extended recreation seasons that are proposed to encourage hunting for wildlife disease management. The data are from an online revealed and stated preference survey of recreational hunters in Alberta, Canada. We find that individuals substitute activities spatially and temporally, take more hunting trips, and gain welfare benefits when they can more flexibly choose the time of activities. Our findings show that increases in time flexibility can be used as an incentive to encourage beneficial outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 当参与休闲活动时，个体决定去哪里（地点）和何时参与（哪些时间段），并且他们会应对外部因素的变化（例如，环境质量变化、激励措施的提供）。在考察经济决策时，经济学家主要关注地点选择，因此与时间选择相关的激励的行为和福利影响在很大程度上是未知的。在本文中，我们开发并估计了一个结合空间和时间选择的灵活计量经济模型。该模型被应用于考察个体在响应为鼓励狩猎以进行野生动物疾病管理而提出的延长休闲季节时，其休闲旅行的地点和时间选择。数据来自加拿大阿尔伯塔省休闲猎人的在线揭示和陈述偏好调查。我们发现，个体在空间和时间上替代活动，进行更多狩猎旅行，并且当他们能更灵活地选择活动时间时获得福利收益。我们的研究结果表明，时间灵活性的增加可以用作鼓励有益结果的激励措施。

articles.title_en: Optimal pricing for carbon dioxide removal under inter-regional leakage
articles.title_cn: 区域间泄漏下二氧化碳移除的最优定价
articles.abstract_en: Carbon dioxide removal (CDR) moves atmospheric carbon to geological or land-based sinks. In a first-best setting, the optimal use of CDR is achieved by a removal subsidy that equals the optimal carbon tax and marginal damages. We derive second-best policy rules for CDR subsidies and carbon taxes when no global carbon price exists but a national government implements a unilateral climate policy. We find that the optimal carbon tax differs from an optimal CDR subsidy because of carbon leakage and a balance of resource trade effect. First, the optimal removal subsidy tends to be larger than the carbon tax because of lower supply-side leakage on fossil resource markets. Second, net carbon exporters exacerbate this wedge to increase producer surplus of their carbon resource producers, implying even larger removal subsidies. Third, net carbon importers may set their removal subsidy even below their carbon tax when marginal environmental damages are small, to appropriate producer surplus from carbon exporters.
articles.abstract_cn: 二氧化碳移除（CDR）将大气中的碳转移到地质或陆地碳汇。在一级最优情境下，CDR的最优使用通过等于最优碳税和边际损害的移除补贴实现。我们推导了当不存在全球碳价格但国家政府实施单边气候政策时，CDR补贴和碳税的二阶最优政策规则。我们发现，由于碳泄漏和资源贸易平衡效应，最优碳税不同于最优CDR补贴。首先，由于化石资源市场上供给侧泄漏较低，最优移除补贴往往大于碳税。其次，净碳出口国加剧了这一楔子，以增加其碳资源生产者的生产者剩余，这意味着更大的移除补贴。第三，当边际环境损害较小时，净碳进口国可能将其移除补贴设定得甚至低于其碳税，以从碳出口国获取生产者剩余。
